name: Measles & vaccine-preventable
summary: US measles cases top 4,800; PAHO elimination review due 10–13 Nov
state: US measles cases passed 4,800 as the disease surges in several states, with 4,852 confirmed by 29 Oct and three deaths (CIDRAP; Tech Times). PAHO's commission meets on 10–13 Nov to review US elimination status, which analysts expect to be lost. The next CDC update is due on 6 Nov.
for_you: Check MMR vaccination status with your GP or doctor, per NHS and CDC advice.
rubric_hit: Large outbreaks in a high-income country = Watch

sources.title: Tech Times — US measles outbreak hits 4,852

why: Falling vaccination rates are bringing back diseases once eliminated; measles is the canary for the rest.

rubric.alert: Multi-country surge with rising deaths, or polio/diphtheria resurgence in high-income countries.
rubric.watch: Large outbreaks in high-income countries, or loss of elimination status.
rubric.normal: No large outbreaks in high-income countries.
